articles.title: Flood: move away from rising water
articles.summary: Recognize immediate danger and choose a safer location.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Move to higher ground when safe and follow local evacuation directions.
Avoid walking or driving through floodwater; depth and road damage can be hidden.
Keep away from fallen wires and electrical equipment exposed to water.

cautions: A saved map cannot tell you whether a road is passable.

articles.title: Earthquake: protect yourself during shaking
articles.summary: Reduce exposure to falling objects.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Drop, take cover under sturdy furniture if available, and hold on.
Stay away from windows. Do not rush outside during shaking.
After shaking stops, check for hazards and be ready for aftershocks.

cautions: Adapt protective actions to your mobility and immediate surroundings.

articles.title: Lost in a desert
articles.summary: Reduce heat exposure while making yourself easier to find.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Seek shade and avoid unnecessary exertion in the hottest part of the day.
If a vehicle is in a safe location, staying with it can make you easier to locate.
Record your coordinates and signal rescuers when possible; do not rely on mobile reception.

cautions: Confusion, collapse, or severe illness needs urgent help. There is no universal survival countdown.

articles.title: Water: treatment and storage
articles.summary: Match treatment to the contamination risk.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Use a known safe water source when available.
For microbial contamination, boil clear water for one minute; above 6,500 feet use three minutes.
Cool safely and store in clean, covered food-grade containers.

cautions: Boiling and disinfection do not make fuel- or toxic-chemical-contaminated water safe.
A cloth removes sediment, not all pathogens.

articles.title: Distillation: understand the limits
articles.summary: A reference to the process, equipment, and limitations.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Distillation evaporates water and collects condensed vapor in a separate clean container.
Use equipment designed for the process and follow its instructions.
Protect treated water from recontamination.

cautions: Some volatile contaminants can pass into the condensate. Unknown contamination requires a safer source.
Never heat a sealed improvised vessel. Steam and hot surfaces cause burns.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Check for hazards before approaching an injured person.
Contact available emergency services and follow dispatcher instructions.
Use first-aid techniques you have been trained to perform.

cautions: This reference is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat conditions.

articles.title: Paracetamol / acetaminophen
articles.summary: General medicine reference: pain and fever relief.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Check the active ingredients in every product; combination cold medicines may contain the same ingredient.
Follow the product label and your clinician's instructions.
Keep the original packaging and protect medicines from excess heat and moisture.

cautions: Too much acetaminophen can cause severe liver damage. Suspected overdose needs urgent medical help even without symptoms.
Ask a clinician about liver disease, alcohol use, interactions, pregnancy, or treatment for a child.

articles.title: Cooking during a power outage
articles.summary: Prepare food without introducing fuel or contamination hazards.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Choose shelf-stable foods that need little preparation.
Keep raw and ready-to-eat foods separate and clean tools with safe water.
Use cooking equipment only in locations allowed by its manufacturer.

cautions: Charcoal grills and fuel-burning camping stoves must not be used indoors or in enclosed spaces.

articles.title: Food storage when refrigeration fails

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Keep refrigerator and freezer doors closed as much as possible.
Use an appliance thermometer and follow food-specific time and temperature guidance.
Discard food when safety is uncertain; tasting cannot determine safety.

cautions: Preservation methods need validated recipes and equipment. Do not improvise canning procedures.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Choose a waste arrangement compatible with local conditions and public-health advice.
Keep waste away from water sources and food storage.
Maintain a hand-cleaning station with safe water and soap.

cautions: Floodwater and sewage may carry hazardous contamination.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Disconnect the device and inspect accessible cables for damage.
Try a known compatible cable and power source if safe.
Consult the device's model-specific manual before disassembly.

cautions: Stop if a battery is swollen, leaking, unusually hot, or damaged.
Do not open mains power supplies or repair live electrical equipment.

articles.title: Mechanical troubleshooting
articles.summary: Inspect before replacing parts.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Make the equipment stable and isolate its energy sources.
Check visible fasteners, obstructions, wear, and alignment.
Record the model and symptoms, then follow its service manual.

cautions: Springs, pressure, heat, and suspended loads can store energy even when power is off.
Safety-critical brakes, steering, and lifting equipment require competent inspection.

Use compatible rated components and the manufacturer's wiring instructions.
Protect equipment from water and inspect connections before use.

cautions: Do not connect a bare solar panel directly to a battery unless the equipment explicitly supports that arrangement.

articles.summary: Devices can communicate locally even without an uplink.

sections.heading: Learn & repair
steps: Power a router and connect devices to its local Wi-Fi network.
Use a unique network password and record the router's local address.

cautions: A local network does not restore global internet. The example server has no authentication or encryption; never expose private files or forward its port to the internet.
